storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Wistia makes it easy to save Wistia-hosted videos to your computer — whether they're on wistia.com or embedded on any other website.

How it works: Navigate to any page with a Wistia video and click the extension icon. The extension automatically detects the Wistia player using 9 different detection methods, fetches all available quality options from the Wistia API, and lets you download the video as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, Wistia's .bin file format, and embedded players on third-party sites automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Choose your quality, click Download, and save.

Key features:
- Detects Wistia videos on any website — not just wistia.com
- 9 detection methods including JSON-LD, async embeds, iframes, and data attributes
- All available quality options from the Wistia API
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Playlist and channel support — browse and download individual videos
- In-page download manager with real-time progress
- Dark-themed UI with Wistia blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to any page with a Wistia video
3. Click the extension icon — it auto-detects the video
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any page with a Wistia video and click the extension icon. The extension auto-detects the embedded player. Select your quality and click Download.

faq.question: Does it work on sites other than wistia.com?
faq.answer: Yes — it detects Wistia players embedded on any website. Course platforms, marketing pages, knowledge bases — anywhere Wistia is used.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension fetches all available renditions from the Wistia API — typically multiple resolutions including the original upload quality. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS streams are automatically converted.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: The extension uses your browser's Save As dialog, so you choose where to save each download.

faq.question: Can I download playlists or channels?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension detects Wistia playlists and channels, shows all videos in a browsable list, and lets you download each one individually.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: What about password-protected videos?
faq.answer: The extension detects password-protected Wistia videos and notifies you. Password-protected videos cannot be downloaded.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
